name: rpf
description: Read and write RAGE Package Format archives
long_description: Six read-mostly tools over RPF2 through RPF7 archives: summarise one, list a path, read an entry as bytes or as its XML view, plan a change set, apply it, and verify every entry against what the archive says. Entry bytes never travel on the wire in either direction — a read writes the file you name, and a write reads the file you name.

tools.name: rpf_info
tools.description: Summarise an archive, or one nested inside it

tools.name: rpf_list
tools.description: List what is at a path, filtered and paged

tools.name: rpf_read
tools.description: Read one entry, as its bytes or as its XML view

tools.name: rpf_plan
tools.description: Report what a change set would do, and write nothing

tools.name: rpf_apply
tools.description: Apply a change set: writes, removals, renames, directories

tools.name: rpf_verify
tools.description: Read every entry back and check it against what the archive says
